extraction.Name: Margaret White Deer
extraction.Recorded patent: I did not record the parent, but delivered the patent when I sold the land, and probably the purchaser had the patent recorded.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I, the patentee, sold the land, all of it, never mortgaged it.
extraction.Buyer: Sold to Mr. Snodgrass, a banker at that time in Interior, S.D. for $1,000.00 cash
extraction.Occupation/Income: A monthly allowance from her Individual Indian Money
extraction.NOTES: Mentally sound, physically poor and feeble; has about $500.00 individual money at the present time, from which she is drawing a monthly allowance for her support. No dependents excepting herself. Sale was considered a fair price for the land at that time. Document notarized December 4, 1928, before Elmer B. Pomeroy, Notary Public, Washington County, State of South Dakota. | TASK 3 BULK TRIBE INFERENCE 2026-04-29: Tribe field set to 'Pine Ridge' based on directory provenance (record is filed in pine_ridge_*/extractions/, which corresponds to the NARA RG 75 Pine Ridge Vol 1, Vol 2, and Vol 3 bound volumes of Circular 2464 responses). 67 such records were originally 'not stated'; 6 received BLM-confirmed substantive patches in the same transaction; the remaining 61 (this record's batch) are inferred from directory and geographic/naming evidence. Inference is rebuttable — any record can be re-evaluated via BLM cross-reference if its Pine Ridge affiliation is questioned.
